profile.description:
Tavily Research performs comprehensive research on a given topic by conducting multiple searches, analyzing sources, and generating a detailed research report.

Note: Responses may take several minutes to complete depending on complexity.

Supported file type upload: PDF, TXT, PNG, JPG, JPEG
Audio and video file upload is not supported.

Parameter controls available:
1. Research Settings
- `--model [mini|pro|auto]`: Select the research model (default: auto)
- `--citation_format [numbered|mla|apa|chicago]`: The format for citations in the research report (default: numbered)
